description: Enhanced allowlist cases: a multi-word allowlist accepts both listed words while an unlisted unknown word is still flagged, and an explicitly empty allowlist accepts nothing so every unknown word is reported. Each reported misspelling is its UTF-8 start byte offset, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"spellcheck","text":<text>,"lang":"text","allow":[words...]}.
